2608.00610.title: Slides2MindMap: Reconstructing Cognitively Efficient Knowledge Hierarchies from Lecture Slides
2608.00610.paper_summary: Generating mind maps from lecture slides can help learners efficiently assimilate fragmented knowledge, promising substantial benefits for intelligent education. However, dedicated automatic generation and evaluation frameworks remain underexplored and challenging, requiring a global-local knowledge focus balance and handling large-scale, heterogeneous slides. We formulate the Slides2MindMap task, which aims to reconstruct cognitively efficient knowledge hierarchies from a course's slide deck collection. For systematic evaluation, we introduce S2M-Bench, a benchmark comprising 12,774 slide pages with expert-annotated mind maps spanning 24 university courses. S2M-Bench includes a cognitive-science-grounded evaluation framework that integrates ground-truth-based comparison, structure conformity analysis, and VLM-as-a-Judge. To address this task, we propose AutoMindMap, an agentic framework inspired by the Structure Building Framework. AutoMindMap comprises Skeleton Laying for global scaffold anchoring, Iterative Knowledge Integration augmented by context-aware summarization, and Dual-Stage Refinement with a local-global decoupling mechanism. The framework reconciles local knowledge faithfulness with global coherence, and adapts to slide-specific features. Experiments on S2M-Bench demonstrate that AutoMindMap outperforms baselines and achieves superior robustness across different models and scenarios, underscoring its pedagogical application value.
2608.00610.paper_summary_zh: 從講義幻燈片生成思維導圖可以幫助學習者有效地吸收零散的知識，對智能教育帶來可觀的好處。<lb/>然而，專門的自動生成和評估框架仍然未被充分探索且具有挑戰性，需要平衡全球與地方知識的聚焦，並處理大規模的異質幻燈片。<lb/>我們制定了Slides2MindMap任務，旨在從課程的幻燈片集重建認知效率高的知識層次結構。<lb/>為了進行系統評估，我們引入了S2M-Bench，這是一個包含12,774頁幻燈片和專家標註的思維導圖，涵蓋24門大學課程的基準。<lb/>S2M-Bench包括一個基於認知科學的評估框架，該框架整合了基於真實數據的比較、結構一致性分析和VLM作為評判者。<lb/>為了解決這一任務，我們提出了AutoMindMap，這是一個受到結構建構框架啟發的代理框架。<lb/>AutoMindMap包括用於全球支架錨定的Skeleton Laying、通過上下文感知摘要增強的Iterative Knowledge Integration，以及具有地方-全球解耦機制的Dual-Stage Refinement。<lb/>該框架調和了地方知識的真實性與全球一致性，並適應幻燈片特定的特徵。<lb/>在S2M-Bench上的實驗表明，AutoMindMap的表現超越了基準，並在不同模型和場景中實現了卓越的穩健性，突顯了其在教學應用中的價值。
